doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Day two opening, February 25, 2009
summary: Brown opens day two at Young's Los Angeles home and asks how he feels.

story.theme_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks
story.community_name: Opening the interview: introductions, date and place

blocks.x: Today is Wednesday, February 25, 2009, we are at the home of Snooky Young, trumpeter, and 90 years young veteran of the jazz world. We are conducting the Smithsonian National Endowment for the Arts Jazz Oral History Program interview at his
home in Los Angeles conducted by Anthony Brown and Kennith Kimery and this is day two of the interview with Snooky Young. So, Snooky, how you feeling today?
I feel a little better than I did yesterday. What I mean by that is, we got one day out of the way, you know what I‘m saying.
So, I hope we can get through this day okay.
[laughs] Well you‘re looking good it seems like we‘re going to be able to get through it, you sounds good, you feel good?
